key_insight: OCT-Bench shows that multimodal LLMs still struggle to reliably understand OCT, especially beyond basic image recognition into clinical reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This benchmark better reflects real OCT interpretation workflows, helping identify where AI tools fall short for retinal disease assessment and decision support.
method: Built OCT-Bench with 10,076 multiple-choice questions from 4,137 OCT images.
Organized evaluation into 20 fine-grained tasks across Perception, Cognition, and Reasoning.
Tested 20 representative MLLMs, including proprietary, general-purpose, and medical-domain models.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that performance remained substantially below reliable OCT understanding, and that neither medical adaptation nor larger model size consistently improved results across capability levels.
watch_item: A benchmark can measure understanding, but it does not by itself prove safe clinical use in real patient workflows.
paper_title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Understand OCT?
